This editorial illustration depicts a caricature of a man in a white button-down shirt. His body is rotund, and his face features a dark mustache and one closed eye. He holds a telescope up to his open right eye. The telescope is black with gold trim; its large lens reflects a yellow five-pointed star on a red background. In his left hand, the man holds a clear plastic bag containing water and several small, dark, oblong shapes.

The man stands against a pale background with a building structure visible on the right. Above him, large red capital letters spell "TEMPO" against a teal sky. Smaller text includes: "Jaringan Perdagangan Video Penyiksaan Hewan H.70" and "Gengsi Profesor Abal-abal H.28".

Large white text at the bottom reads: "DEMI LOBSTER KAWAN VIETNAM". Below this is a paragraph starting: "Menteri Kelautan dan Perikanan Sakti Wahyu Trenggono membuat aturan baru budi daya dan ekspor benur lobster." The upper right corner displays a barcode, QR code, and price information for "22-28 APRIL 2024".
